name: cat_hugged_key
desc: keep the same little black witch cat, same face with eyes shut, same hat, cape, colors, size, legs, feet and tail. Change only its arms: both arms reach toward the left and wrap around as if hugging, both paws tucked in on the far left side at chest height, the right arm crosses in front of its chest toward the left, no paw on the right side. Nothing else added, no objects.
